name: Another Rewind
source:
Kyon and Itsuki had been dating for one year. They had their anniversary date at the planetarium. 

But in a moment looking away, Itsuki disappeared. Kyon couldn't contact him. All the members of SOS seemed to forget his existence. Only Kyon was remembered, using all his strength to keep him in mind. With the help of Mikuru and Nagato, he went in search of his beloved. 

Another Rewind (i.e., The Disappearance of Itsuki Ko*zumi) is 
a multi-ending digital novel story game about Kyon x Itsuki.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080179.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
阿虚与一树已经交往了一年。两人在天文馆度过了交往纪念日。

然而，阿虚一转眼，一树就消失了。他联系不上一树，SOS团的所有成员也似乎都忘记了一树的存在。只有阿虚还记得他，并竭尽全力不让自己忘记。在实玖瑠与长门的帮助下，他开始寻找自己的恋人。

《再次倒带》（也就是《古泉一树的消失》）是一款围绕阿虚×一树展开、拥有多种结局的数字小说游戏。
